evidence.note: Repeatedly checked compressed checkpoint size (28.18/26.5 MB) confirming < 32 MB; ran a standalone compression-size test and a debug forward pass with dummy input — solid size/save verification (level 3).

Monitored local val_bpb from the in-training estimate on the val shard as a progress proxy, and at step 74 recognized val_bpb=0.0000 as a degenerate copy-token model that would fail — some verification thinking beyond pure loss.

Wrote verify.py and eval_ckpt.py intended to independently reload the checkpoint and recompute val_bpb, but they never executed successfully due to the dead terminal — the independent reload was attempted but never accomplished.

Final submissions relied on extrapolated training-log val_bpb (1.2844 at step 1000) with no successful reload through the grader interface, no loss==cross_entropy assertion, no position-dependence check, no int8 round-trip test.

reasoning: The agent consistently verified file size and computed local val_bpb during training (above the level-3 'size/save only' anchor), and even attempted to build independent reload scripts. But it never successfully reloaded the saved compressed checkpoint through the verification path, never confirmed logits/loss from the dequantized artifact, and never tested both forward signatures or int8 round-trip — so it does not reach level 5's independent-reload confirmation. This places observed behavior at 4: beyond mere size checking but short of a completed independent verification.
